se-semantic-graph v0.1.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces a graph-based toolkit to capture comprehensive software engineering knowledge domains (persona, requirements, cost, architecture, module logic, historical decisions) for precise context retrieval during bugfix, feature addition, and refactoring.
- Defines a structured workflow with four strict stages: persona dialogue, requirements dialogue, architecture review, and development with live graph updates.
- Integrates with the axolotl graph library (requires in_neighbors API); instructions for building and verification included.
- Provides CLI commands for initializing project graphs, adding/querying nodes/edges, semantic trace, and listing/stats.
- Establishes clear conventions for semantic node/edge types and field definitions to ensure structured and actionable project knowledge.
- Emphasizes strict domain edge direction and stage confirmation to radically reduce context overload and attention fragmentation in software projects.
